title: Program requests
description: Propose programs, follow their approval and see the projects and initiatives they become.
projectsDescription: Created automatically when a program request receives its final approval.

start.title: How do you want to start?
start.manualHint: Answer the request form step by step.
start.documentHint: Upload a case study, business case or proposal (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Arabic or English). AI fills the form for your review.
start.noAi: AI is not available: fill the form manually.
start.filled: {{count}} values proposed from {{files}} document(s). Review each one before saving.

fields.name: Program
fields.requiresBudget: Does the program require a budget?
fields.costPath: Do you have a cost estimation file?
fields.screenCoreWork: Is the work core to the unit?
fields.screenOneTime: Is it done once, without repetition?
fields.screenTimeBound: Does it have a specific time period?
fields.screenUniqueOutput: Does it produce unique results or outputs?
fields.othersCoverImplementation: Do other parties cover the implementation?
fields.practices: Link with internal practices (fill Operation or Service)

values.cost-estimation: Yes — I will upload the cost estimation file
values.project-scope: No — send the project scope to Administration for quotations

live.totalOk: Year 1–4 costs equal the estimated budget.
live.totalMismatch: Year 1–4 costs must equal the estimated budget exactly.
live.classificationHint: A Project when every answer is Yes and the budget is above {{amount}}; otherwise an Initiative.
live.scorePending: Score every criterion to see the evaluation score.

hints.filesAfterSave: Save the draft first; then upload the cost estimation file or the project scope from the request page.
hints.dates: The start date must be within this year or the next {{years}} years; the end date at most {{years}} years after this year.
hints.review: Your answers are saved as a draft. Submit the request for approval from its page.
hints.noObjectives: No strategic objectives are configured yet: ask the Strategy Office (Settings → KPI → Strategy hierarchy).

dialogs.overrideHint: The computed classification stays visible; your choice and reason are recorded.
dialogs.budgetHint: Set the budget you approve before deciding. If you leave it, the estimated budget is approved.

toast.quotations: Quotations confirmed; the requester was notified

files.title: Cost estimation, project scope and quotations

assessment.title: Proposal Assessment
assessment.description: Written by AI from the request and its documents. Suggestions only: people decide.
assessment.similar: Similar or overlapping requests and projects

projects.nextPhase: Take Ownership, the charter and the project lifecycle arrive with the project phase.

settings.title: Portfolio
settings.description: Threshold, prioritisation criteria and bands, date windows, the budget step and the project scope template.
settings.thresholdHint: Used by the classification rule and the DG Office step of the approval chain.
settings.startYearsAhead: Start date window (years after this year)
settings.endYearsAhead: End date window (years after this year)
settings.budgetStepCode: Approval step that sets the approved budget
settings.assessmentOnCreate: Write the Proposal Assessment when a request is created from documents
settings.lifecycleHint: Stage templates per classification (Q-P2 / Q-P3), the monthly update cycle and the change request threshold. New projects take the template at creation.
settings.progressToleranceHint: Delayed when approved progress is more than this below plan.
settings.gmThreshold: GM Office threshold for change requests
settings.gmThresholdHint: Cost changes above this amount also go to the GM Office.

currentStatus.draft: Waiting for the requester to submit the request for approval
currentStatus.returned: Returned for correction: waiting for the requester to resubmit
currentStatus.uploadCostEstimation: Waiting for the requester to upload the cost estimation file
currentStatus.uploadScope: Waiting for the requester to upload the project scope
currentStatus.sendScope: Project scope uploaded: waiting for the requester to send it to Administration
currentStatus.waitingQuotations: Waiting for the Administration Dept to upload quotations
currentStatus.takeOwnership: Waiting for an employee of the section to take ownership

project.takeOwnership: Waiting for an employee of the section to take ownership
project.fillMinimums: Fill at least 1 KPI, 1 risk, 1 stakeholder, 3 team members and the high-level plan
project.submitCharter: Waiting for the project manager to submit the charter for approval
project.charterReturned: The charter was returned: correct it and submit again
project.waitingLpo: Waiting for the Administration Dept to upload the LPO
project.waitingTeam: Waiting for the PM Office to form the project team
project.updatePlanning: Waiting for the project manager to update the planning details
project.addMilestones: Waiting for the project manager to add all milestones (total weight 100 %)
project.submitPlanning: Waiting for the project manager to submit the planning for approval
project.planningReturned: The planning was returned: correct it and submit again
project.noWindow: No monthly update window is open
project.monthlyOpen: Monthly update {{period}} is open: update the milestones and submit
project.monthlyReturned: Monthly update {{period}} was returned: correct it and submit again
project.confirmCompletion: All work is achieved: waiting for the PM Office to confirm completion
project.submitClosure: Waiting for the project manager to submit the project closure
project.closureReturned: The closure was returned: correct it and submit again
project.enterImpact: Waiting for the project manager to enter the impact
project.impactReturned: The impact was returned: correct it and submit again

myWork.uploadLpo: Upload the LPO and contract details

errors.yearCostsMismatch: Year 1–4 costs ({{total}}) must equal the estimated budget ({{budget}}).
errors.startOutOfRange: The start date must be between {{from}} and {{to}}.
errors.endOutOfRange: The end date must be on or before {{to}}.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.operationOrService: Fill the linked Operation or the linked Service.
errors.previousProgramRequired: Name the previous program of a continuous program.
errors.twoDecimals: Enter an amount with at most 2 decimals.
errors.priorityRequired: Score every priority criterion from 1 to 5.
errors.costEstimationMissing: Upload the cost estimation file before submitting.
errors.quotationsMissing: Wait for Administration's quotations before submitting.
errors.alreadyHandedOff: The project scope was already sent to Administration.
errors.notWaitingQuotations: This request is not waiting for quotations.
errors.noAdministration: No one holds the Administration Dept role: ask the PM Office to assign it.
errors.overrideReasonRequired: Give the reason for the classification.
errors.notAllowedInStatus: This action is not available at this stage of the request.
errors.criteriaRequired: Keep at least one active criterion.
errors.bandsStartAtZero: The lowest band must start at 0 %.
errors.achieveAboveWeight: The achievement must be between 0 and the milestone weight ({{weight}} %).
errors.achieveBelowApproved: The achievement cannot be lower than the approved {{approved}} %.
errors.actualEndInFuture: The actual end date cannot be in the future.
errors.actualEndRequired: A completed milestone needs its actual end date.
errors.actualStartRequired: Enter the actual start date with the first achievement.
errors.approvalInProgress: An approval is in progress for this project. Recall the pending approval first (with a reason), then try again.
errors.causalityRequired: The milestone is delayed: explain the cause.
errors.changeNothing: The change request proposes no change.
errors.correctiveActionsRequired: The milestone is delayed: enter the corrective actions.
errors.deliverableFields: Deliverables need the main deliverable and the acceptance criteria.
errors.evidenceRequired: A completed milestone needs at least one evidence file.
errors.gateLessons: Add at least one lesson learned.
errors.gateMembers: Add at least {{min}} team members ({{count}} now).
errors.gatePm: The project needs a project manager.
errors.gateScope: Add at least one in-scope item.
errors.headerChange: This milestone cannot change between phase and milestone now.
errors.itemInactive: This row is no longer active.
errors.kpiCardUnknown: Choose a KPI card you can see.
errors.mergeTarget: Choose another active project to merge into.
errors.milestoneDates: Every milestone needs planned start and end dates (end after start).
errors.milestoneHasAchievement: A milestone with approved achievement cannot be cancelled.
errors.milestoneNotUpdatable: This milestone cannot be updated now.
errors.notAllowedInStage: Not allowed at this stage of the project.
errors.parentInvalid: Choose an active phase of the same plan.
errors.templateNeedsCharter: LPO and team formation need the charter step.
errors.weightBelowAchieved: The weight cannot be lower than the approved achievement.
errors.weightRange: The weight must be above 0 % and at most 100 %.
errors.windowAlreadyOpen: A monthly update window is already open.
errors.windowClosed: No monthly update window is open.
errors.nothingToRecall: There is no pending approval to recall.
errors.boardNeedsTodoAndDone: The board needs at least one to-do column and one done column.
errors.columnNotEmpty: A column that still has stories cannot be removed; move the stories first.
errors.dependencySelf: A milestone cannot depend on itself.
errors.epicHasApprovedStories: An epic with approved done stories cannot be cancelled.
errors.epicMilestone: In a hybrid project an epic belongs to a milestone delivered in sprints; in an agile project it has no milestone.
errors.featureOff: This feature is switched off in Settings → Portfolio.
errors.gateBenefits: Measure every expected benefit before submitting the impact.
errors.gateQuality: Every deliverable must be quality-accepted before closure.
errors.gateReleases: Add at least one release to the release plan.
errors.hybridEpicsNot100: The epics of each sprint-delivered milestone must total 100% ({{count}} milestone(s) do not).
errors.justificationRequired: Enter the justification of the override.
errors.methodologyLocked: After the charter the methodology changes only through an approved change request.
errors.noApprovedUpdate: There is no approved monthly update for this period.
errors.noBaseline: There is no baseline yet; it is taken at planning approval.
errors.notAgile: This project is not delivered in sprints.
errors.notDeliverable: This milestone is not a deliverable.
errors.notDraft: The request can be changed only while it is a draft.
errors.rebaselineType: Re-baselining is available for details and postponement change requests only.
errors.sprintAlreadyActive: A sprint is already active; close it first.
errors.sprintEmpty: Add stories to the sprint before starting it.
errors.sprintLength: A sprint lasts 1 to 28 days and ends after it starts.
errors.sprintMonthlyMode: This project approves sprints in the monthly roll-up; submit the monthly update.
errors.sprintNotAllowed: This action is not allowed in the sprint's status.
errors.sprintNotOpen: The chosen sprint is not open.
errors.storyLocked: This story's completion is approved; it cannot be moved back.
errors.thresholdOrder: The red threshold must be at least the amber threshold, between 0 and 1.
errors.wipLimit: The column reached its WIP limit ({{limit}}).
errors.waselTransition: This action is not possible while the item is “{{status}}”.
errors.waselAlreadyDecided: This item has already been decided.
errors.vendorDuplicate: A vendor with this trade licence number already exists.
errors.accessUntilRequired: Enter the date the vendor's access ends (or link a contract with an end date).
errors.accessUntilPast: The access end date cannot be in the past.
errors.vendorNotAssigned: The vendor is not assigned to this project.
errors.vendorUserOtherVendor: This e-mail belongs to a user of another vendor.
errors.vendorUserDisabled: This vendor user is disabled; reactivate the account first.
errors.vendorMilestoneLeaf: Only detailed milestones (not phases or high-level items) can be assigned to a vendor.
errors.waselNotReviewable: This vendor update is not waiting for review.
errors.vendorRatingStage: The overall vendor rating is given at closure or later.
errors.proposalEmpty: The proposed plan has no items.
errors.proposalKeys: Every proposed item needs its own unique key.
errors.outsideProjectDates: The dates must be within the project's planned dates.
errors.proposalOpen: There is already an open plan proposal for this project.
errors.vendorItemLocked: The project manager already accepted this milestone update.
errors.vendorNothingToSubmit: There is nothing new to submit.
errors.vendorPmOnlyMode: Milestones of this project are updated by the project manager only.
errors.vendorSubmissionLocked: The update was submitted and is waiting for the project manager.
errors.vendorSubmissionPending: A vendor update is waiting for your review: accept or return it before submitting the month.

warnings.openTasks: This milestone still has open tasks: close or cancel them.

project.removeHint: The row is kept in the history as inactive.

toast.owner: You are now the project manager

statusDialog.holdHint: Everything becomes read-only until the project is resumed.
statusDialog.cancelHint: Cancelling is final; any approval in progress stops.

kpi.hint: New KPIs of the project, or existing KPI cards of Performance Management.

risk.hint: Probability × impact on 5 × 5; the existing control evaluation lowers the residual score.
risk.title: Risk

team.proposedHint: The charter needs at least 3 members ({{count}} now). The formal team is formed in Teams Management.
team.formation: The project team is formed through Teams Management
team.formationHint: PM Office: request a team with this project linked. When the formation is approved, its members get access to the project and the project moves to Planning.

lpo.title: Local purchase order (LPO)
lpo.confirmed: LPO confirmed; the PM Office is notified

milestones.highLevelHint: Charter: the main phases, weights total 100 %.
milestones.detailedHint: Planning: milestones and phases, leaf weights total exactly 100 %.
milestones.title: Title
milestones.achieveHint: Between the approved {{approved}} % and the weight {{weight}} %.
milestones.completeHint: Complete: actual end and evidence required

monthly.none: No window is open. The window opens on the first working day of each month.
monthly.opened: The monthly update window is open

change.hint: Details, postponement, ownership, cancellation or merge. Approved changes apply only when the PM confirms them.
change.applyHint: Pre-filled from the approved request. Check the values: they are applied and logged when you confirm.
change.cancelsProject: Applying this request cancels the project.

impact.title: Project impact
impact.hint: After-project results; the PM Office approves and the project is completed.
impact.costHint: Ratio of planned to actual cost (1 = on budget).

recall.title: Recall the pending approval
recall.hint: The running approval is cancelled and the record goes back to where it was before submission, so it can be corrected or the project put on hold.
